vectors.intent_statement: Bound Muse to champion coordination and public Creator floor operations under an active dispatch.
Limit Music Studio coordination to bounded reports and Muse-issued delegations without sibling authority.
Limit Writers coordination to bounded reports and Muse-issued delegations without sibling authority.
Bound the Living-World Floor build to its authorized public TypeScript surfaces and deterministic pre-flight.
Make every Creator external dependency, credential boundary, health signal, and quiet fallback explicit.
Provide the CGRF envelope for the dispatch memory ingest payload.
Define deterministic structure levels from cumulative verified creative output without fabricated progress.
Provide the CGRF envelope for the reproducible public npm dependency lockfile.
Bind the generated CycloneDX dependency inventory to the authorized integration dispatch.
Bind the generated CycloneDX dependency inventory to the authorized integration dispatch.
Start the public Creator realm service with quiet-floor degradation when NATS is unavailable.
Declare lifecycle ownership for observed Creator activity aggregation.
Verify activity derives only from deduplicated events and fresh bounded sub-guild reports.
Derive floor activity only from deduplicated observed work and fresh sub-guild reports.
Declare lifecycle ownership for authenticated integration event coordination.
Translate authenticated observed integration events into bounded floor, analytics, and notification operations.
Declare lifecycle ownership for dispatch-bound Customer.io hooks.
Send dispatch-authorized creative notifications using opaque member identifiers and bounded role segments.
Declare lifecycle ownership for the read-only self-hosted GitLab bridge.
Verify GitLab requests remain read-only and private records reduce to public-safe quest metadata.
Pull only whitelisted GitLab metadata and translate real status changes into public-safe floor state.
Verify typed guild messages require dispatch authority and the integration runtime closes quietly without configuration.
Declare lifecycle ownership for typed Creator cross-guild communications.
Enforce typed parent and cross-guild messages and aggregate only authorized sub-guild status reports.
Declare lifecycle ownership for authenticated n8n workflow ingress.
Authenticate bounded n8n workflow events before they can change public Creator floor state.
Verify analytics and notification writes require dispatch authorization and fail-closed flags.
Declare lifecycle ownership for the Creator PostHog adapter.
Track public-safe guild engagement and fail closed external operations behind PostHog flags.
Declare lifecycle ownership for the external integration runtime.
Start and stop configured integrations under active-dispatch and feature-flag circuit breakers.
Verify private rows and signed workflow events reduce to authorized public floor operations.
Declare lifecycle ownership for public-safe Supabase Realtime activity.
Reduce Supabase Realtime rows to public-safe observed activity identifiers and statuses.
Verify mobile realm loading, privacy-safe RUM setup, and quiet degradation on invalid data.
Load the public Creator floor for mobile clients with quiet fallback and privacy-safe RUM vitals.
Declare lifecycle ownership for mobile PostHog engagement and flags.
Verify mobile analytics segments opaque members and gates optional experiences with PostHog flags.
Track role-segmented mobile engagement and fail closed mobile features behind PostHog flags.
Verify the public GET contracts expose the quiet floor and Muse without accepting writes.
Expose the public Creator realm and Muse party bindings as read-only JSON contracts.
Enforce deterministic tests and at least eighty percent coverage on the new floor contract.
